Investigators copied an account identifier incorrectly. The article explains how that single character changed the direction of the investigation and why later checks failed to catch the mistake.

The court record is available through a normal article link, and the reporting continues after the figure without becoming boilerplate.

Records from the service provider showed that the requested account and the account returned by the search were not the same. That discrepancy should have prompted another verification step before investigators relied on the result.

An appeals court later reviewed the sequence of events and explained why the mistaken identifier mattered. The reporting preserves the chronology and links to the supporting documents for readers.
